## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.cb5529be"></a>**1. The unit backend/src/common/validators contains a single source file, pdf-content.validator.ts, which holds the application's PDF content validation logic.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:1-73`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L1-L73)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.a52803bf"></a>**2. validatePdfContent is an exported async function that takes a PDF file buffer and returns a Promise<PdfType>, validating the PDF content and detecting the schedule mode by checking for mode-identifying keywords in the first page.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:18-49`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L18-L49)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.b49da522"></a>**3. isPdfValidUpSchedule is an exported async function that checks whether a buffer is a valid UP schedule PDF without throwing, returning { isValid: true, pdfType } on success and { isValid: false, error } on failure, where error is the thrown message or 'Unknown error'.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:58-72`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L58-L72)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.ef7d2a73"></a>**4. UploadService.processUpload in backend/src/upload/upload.service.ts imports validatePdfContent and calls it with the uploaded file's buffer to determine the PDF type, throwing a BadRequestException with the validation error message if validation fails.**
  [`upload.service.ts:6-6`](../../../upload/upload.service.ts#L6-L6)
  [`upload.service.ts:51-57`](../../../upload/upload.service.ts#L51-L57)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.47ffdba6"></a>**5. The file imports PdfType from '../types.js' and PDFParse from the 'pdf-parse' package.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:1-2`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L1-L2)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.9b47ae2b"></a>**6. PdfType is an enum defined in backend/src/common/types.ts with the values LECTURE = 'lecture', TEST = 'test', and EXAM = 'exam'.**
  [`types.ts:1-5`](../../types.ts#L1-L5)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.941928f3"></a>**7. validatePdfContent extracts text from the first page only, using a PDFParse instance constructed with the buffer and parser.getText({ first: 1 }), and throws 'Invalid PDF: Unable to extract text content' if extraction fails.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:25-33`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L25-L33)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.2fc0a41c"></a>**8. validatePdfContent first checks the PDF magic bytes: it reads the first five bytes of the buffer as ASCII and throws 'Invalid PDF: file does not start with PDF magic bytes' unless they start with '%PDF-'.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:19-23`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L19-L23)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.f528bbdf"></a>**9. validatePdfContent detects the schedule mode by keyword, in order: text containing 'Semester Tests' returns PdfType.TEST, 'Exams' returns PdfType.EXAM, and 'Lectures' returns PdfType.LECTURE; the source comment notes the order matters so 'Semester Tests' is checked before 'Exams'.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:35-45`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L35-L45)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.288dcff4"></a>**10. If none of the mode keywords is found, validatePdfContent throws 'Invalid PDF: Not a recognized UP schedule format'.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:47-48`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L47-L48)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.2b0e1f4b"></a>**11. isPdfValidUpSchedule calls validatePdfContent inside a try/catch to obtain the PDF type.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:63-65`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L63-L65)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.82ea47d1"></a>**12. The file defines and exports an enum PdfContentError with the members INVALID_PDF_CONTENT, UNRECOGNIZED_FORMAT, and TEXT_EXTRACTION_FAILED.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:4-8`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L4-L8)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.724eb903"></a>**13. The PdfContentError enum is not referenced anywhere in the repository; the validation functions throw plain Error objects with descriptive message strings rather than PdfContentError values.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:4-8`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L4-L8)
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:22-22`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L22-L22)
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:32-32`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L32-L32)
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:48-48`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L48-L48)
- <a id="research.backend-src-common-validators.153ec0f0"></a>**14. No test files exist for this unit: no test files sit inside backend/src/common/validators, none name a file in it from a mirrored test tree, and none are named for the unit itself.**
  [`pdf-content.validator.ts:1-73`](../pdf-content.validator.ts#L1-L73)
